purpose: One development adaptation after paired nuisance/cadence controls
new_labels: strict physical truth when target visibility proxy passes; unknown when neither view has 64 target pixels
nuisance_training: add physically valid, visible training-scene interventions after observed eligible completion-to-other flip
original_training: all original v2 training clips; no original validation or consumed test in optimizer
confirmation: positive at every 20 Hz control for 0.5 seconds; negative/unknown/missing control resets
validation: four new development validation trajectories; original validation held/wrong/above/outside/recent-drop and blackouts as auxiliary regressions
selection: passing development event and auxiliary gates first; otherwise minimize premature stops, missed events, post-stop failures, late confirmations, auxiliary errors, then max delay
stop_probe: 40 physical controls holding current arm pose with open gripper; scorer has private simulator truth
live_validation: selected checkpoint only; same four development validation seeds, actual VLA loop stops on RGB confirmation
independent_acceptance: not run in this development experiment; old NO-GO and consumed holdout remain frozen
